articles.summary: The new platform brings together fiat and stablecoin capabilities, making it easier to move and manage any form of money. Mastercard and BVNK today announced the launch of Mastercard Global Money Platform, bringing together Mastercard’s global payments capabilities with BVNK’s stablecoin infrastructure through a single API . The launch marks the first major integration of Mastercard and BVNK capabilities since the acquisition of BVNK in August 2026. Global Money Platform provides a full-stack, modular infrastructure layer for modern finance. Banks, fintechs and enterprises can now embed multi-currency accounts, including fiat and stablecoins, real-time conversion, stablecoin-linked cards and local bank payouts through Mastercard Move into their own products and under their own brand. They can also use the platform to manage their own treasury, payments and settlement activity directly. articles.title: Mastercard and BVNK Launch Global Money Platform to Power a Multi-Money World

articles.summary: On Thursday, October 29, 2026, Mastercard Incorporated (NYSE: MA) will release its third quarter 2026 financial results. The company will host a conference call to discuss these results at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time. The financial results will be posted on the company’s website at investor.mastercard.com . The company will issue an alert over a news wire when the earnings materials are publicly available, including a link to those documents.
